lines.zh: 我贴着棉花糖云滑过去，翅膀不发一声。
lines.en: I glide past the candy clouds without a sound.

lines.zh: 从远处看我很友善，靠近了才闻见肉豆蔻。
lines.en: From afar I look kind; up close you smell the nutmeg.

lines.zh: 翅膀是姜饼做的，飞久了会掉糖渣。
lines.en: My wings are gingerbread; flying shakes loose the sugar crumbs.

lines.zh: 我在空中画一个圈，再朝你俯冲。
lines.en: I trace a circle in the air, then dive at you.

lines.zh: 糖霜顺着羽轴往下滴，我懒得舔。
lines.en: Icing drips down my quills; I cannot be bothered to lick it.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我的影子正从你头顶落下。
lines.en: Do not look up; my shadow is already falling on your head.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，但落点总是你的肩膀。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I always land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 曲奇碎在我羽毛里，飞起来沙沙响。
lines.en: Cookie crumbs rattle in my feathers whenever I take off.

lines.zh: 这一带的风带甜味，我顺着它巡一圈。
lines.en: The wind here tastes sweet; I ride it on patrol.

lines.zh: 我落在糖树枝上，枝条被压弯了。
lines.en: I land on a candy branch and it bends under me.

lines.zh: 俯冲之前我会先收起爪子，省得卡住。
lines.en: Before diving I tuck my talons so they do not snag.

lines.zh: 你们管这叫迁徙，我管这叫找糖。
lines.en: You call it migration; I call it hunting for sugar.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇三下就够我越过整片软糖原。
lines.en: Three wingbeats carry me across the whole gummy plain.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落地的鸟容易被抓住。
lines.en: I do not land; grounded birds get grabbed too easily.

lines.zh: 我振翅时抖下一层糖粉。
lines.en: Every wingbeat shakes off a layer of sugar.

lines.zh: 我沿着糖浆河的弯，慢慢滑翔。
lines.en: I glide slowly along the bend of the syrup river.

lines.zh: 我在半空停住，像被线吊着的甜点心。
lines.en: I hover in place like a sweet pastry hung on a string.

lines.zh: 羽毛上的糖壳硬了，我用喙敲碎。
lines.en: The sugar shell on my feathers hardened; I crack it with my beak.

lines.zh: 肉豆蔻味是我身上唯一的警告。
lines.en: That nutmeg smell is the only warning I give.

lines.zh: 我数着下面的姜饼人，少了一个。
lines.en: I count the gingerbread men below; one is missing.

lines.zh: 风一停，我就得自己扇翅膀，真麻烦。
lines.en: When the wind stops I must flap myself; what a nuisance.

lines.zh: 我歪头，糖粒从耳羽里掉出来。
lines.en: I tilt my head and sugar falls from my ear tufts.

lines.zh: 这棵树是薄荷做的，我不喜欢它的味道。
lines.en: This tree is peppermint; I do not care for its taste.

lines.zh: 我在等一只走神的虫，或者走神的你。
lines.en: I wait for a careless bug, or a careless you.

lines.zh: 翅膀收起来时，我看起来能吃了。
lines.en: With wings folded, I look good enough to eat.

lines.zh: 远处那块糖岩，是我最喜欢的哨位。
lines.en: That sugar rock in the distance is my favorite lookout.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，喷出一点姜粉。
lines.en: I burp, and a little ginger dust puffs out.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得糖衣发黏，我甩了甩。
lines.en: The sun makes my sugar coat sticky; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 你站得很近，近到我能闻出你的盐味。
lines.en: You stand close enough for me to smell the salt on you.

lines.zh: 别被这双圆眼睛骗了，我在算距离。
lines.en: Do not trust these round eyes; I am measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 你手里的曲奇，比我窝里的香。
lines.en: The cookie in your hand smells better than my nest.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脖子，那里没有糖壳。
lines.en: I stare at your neck; there is no sugar shell there.

lines.zh: 你眨一下眼，我就往前挪半寸。
lines.en: Every time you blink, I inch half a step closer.

lines.zh: 你看起来不害怕，这让我有点犹豫。
lines.en: You do not look afraid, and that makes me hesitate.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，是在找翅膀的缝。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, hunting a gap in your wings.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着别处的泥土，挺新鲜。
lines.en: Your boots carry soil from somewhere else; how fresh.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我记得那种笑，是诱饵。
lines.en: You smile; I know that smile, it is bait.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，肉豆蔻味就会盖住你。
lines.en: One step closer and the nutmeg will cover your scent.

lines.zh: 糖壳裂了，露出里面更软的姜。
lines.en: My sugar shell cracked open, showing softer ginger beneath.

lines.zh: 疼，但这味道我还是喜欢的。
lines.en: It hurts, though I still like how it tastes.

lines.zh: 你打断了一根羽毛，它还会长。
lines.en: You broke a feather; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 别打了，我的糖霜要掉光了。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; my icing is falling off.

lines.zh: 这一下让我闻到自己的肉豆蔻味。
lines.en: That blow made me smell my own nutmeg.

lines.zh: 我摔进灌木，浑身都是曲奇渣。
lines.en: I crash into a bush covered in cookie crumbs.

lines.zh: 翅膀还在，那就还能飞走。
lines.en: My wings are intact, so I can still fly away.

lines.zh: 你打得准，我承认，但别再来一次。
lines.en: You hit well, I admit it, but not again.

lines.zh: 糖衣护不住骨头，我早知道。
lines.en: Sugar coating cannot guard bone; I always knew.

lines.zh: 我往高处退，那里你够不着。
lines.en: I retreat higher, where your reach ends.

lines.zh: 糖？我只是路过，不是来吃你的。
lines.en: Sugar? I am only passing through, not here to eat yours.

lines.zh: 你把糖举高，是把我当孩子哄。
lines.en: You hold the sugar high, coaxing me like a child.

lines.zh: 我不吃别人手里的，我只抢。
lines.en: I do not eat from hands; I take what I want.

lines.zh: 那股甜味让我的爪子松了一下。
lines.en: That sweetness loosens my grip for a moment.

lines.zh: 别晃，糖渣掉地上我就看不见你了。
lines.en: Stop waving it; if crumbs fall I lose sight of you.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，但我靠的是牙，不是胃口。
lines.en: I am coming closer with my teeth, not my appetite.

lines.zh: 一块糖换一条命，你觉得划算吗。
lines.en: One lump of sugar for a life; do you find that fair?

lines.zh: 我闻到姜饼曲奇，脚就不听使唤。
lines.en: I smell gingerbread cookies and my feet stop obeying me.

lines.zh: 你在喂我，还是在量我的翅展。
lines.en: Are you feeding me, or measuring my wingspan?

lines.zh: 先咬糖，再咬你，顺序不会变。
lines.en: Sugar first, then you; the order does not change.

lines.zh: 撞上你了，我的糖壳碎了一角。
lines.en: I hit you, and a corner of my sugar shell cracks.

lines.zh: 让开，我的俯冲改不了方向。
lines.en: Move aside; my dive cannot change direction now.

lines.zh: 这一下不是我故意的，是风推的。
lines.en: That was not me, the wind shoved me into you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，糖渣落了一地。
lines.en: We collide and sugar crumbs rain on the ground.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀比看起来硬，我记住了。
lines.en: Your shoulder is harder than it looks; noted.

lines.zh: 别把我当球拍，我不是那个材质的。
lines.en: Do not use me as a racket; I am not that material.

lines.zh: 撞完我头晕，翅膀还在自己扇。
lines.en: After the bump I am dizzy but my wings keep flapping.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就能重新起飞。
lines.en: Take half a step back and I can take off again.

lines.zh: 姜饼碰肉，碎的总是姜饼。
lines.en: When gingerbread meets flesh, the gingerbread always breaks.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛卡在你盔甲缝里了。
lines.en: One of my feathers is stuck in your armor seam.

lines.zh: 我跳这支舞，是为了让翅膀不漏风。
lines.en: I dance this way so my wings do not leak air.

lines.zh: 帮我理一理背上的糖霜，够不着。
lines.en: Help me smooth the icing on my back; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 窝搭在糖树顶上，风大但没人来。
lines.en: Our nest sits atop a candy tree: windy, but private.

lines.zh: 我叼了一块最大的曲奇给你。
lines.en: I brought you the largest cookie I could carry.

lines.zh: 两只鸟一起扇，糖粉像雪一样落。
lines.en: Two of us flap together and sugar falls like snow.

lines.zh: 翅膀碰翅膀，这就算说好了。
lines.en: Wing against wing; that counts as an agreement.

lines.zh: 你守夜，我守白天，轮着来。
lines.en: You watch the night, I watch the day; we take turns.

lines.zh: 别把窝里的糖吃了，那是给雏鸟的。
lines.en: Do not eat the sugar in the nest; it is for the chicks.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞三圈，这不算浪费时间。
lines.en: I circle you three times; the flight is not wasted.

lines.zh: 等糖壳长硬了，我们就去更甜的林子。
lines.en: When the sugar shell hardens, we fly to sweeter woods.

lines.zh: 这块糖归我了，你手松了。
lines.en: This sugar is mine now; your grip slipped.

lines.zh: 我叼起曲奇，飞得比平时慢。
lines.en: I pick up a cookie and fly slower than usual.

lines.zh: 地上那颗姜饼翅膀，我认得。
lines.en: That gingerbread wing on the ground; I know it.

lines.zh: 掉的东西都是我的，规矩就这样。
lines.en: Dropped things belong to me; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用两只爪子抱着飞。
lines.en: Too heavy; I carry it in both talons and fly.

lines.zh: 别捡，那是我留给自己的糖霜块。
lines.en: Do not pick that up; I saved it for myself.

lines.zh: 我藏糖的地方，连风都找不到。
lines.en: I hide my sugar where even the wind cannot find it.

lines.zh: 一捡东西我的俯冲就歪了。
lines.en: Grabbing things throws off my dive.

lines.zh: 你掉的每个碎屑，我都数着。
lines.en: I count every crumb that falls from you.

lines.zh: 先放下，等我飞起来再抢。
lines.en: Put it down; I will take it once I am airborne.

lines.zh: 你走路的节奏，正好是俯冲的拍子。
lines.en: Your footfall is exactly the rhythm of a dive.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，从你踩碎那颗糖开始。
lines.en: I have you; it started when you crushed that candy.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来的猎物更好追。
lines.en: Do not run; running prey is easier to chase.

lines.zh: 你今天没带曲奇，那就带点别的。
lines.en: No cookies today? Then bring something else.

lines.zh: 我在你背后，你头发被风吹乱了。
lines.en: I am behind you; the wind stirred your hair.

lines.zh: 这个高度正合适，爪子能勾住衣领。
lines.en: This height is perfect; my talons will catch your collar.

lines.zh: 你转身的样子，像在给我让路。
lines.en: The way you turn looks like you are clearing my path.

lines.zh: 我选了你就不会换，鸟也有脾气。
lines.en: I chose you and will not switch; birds have pride.

lines.zh: 你的心跳声，我在十米外就听见了。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat from ten paces away.

lines.zh: 翅膀压低了，这是要动手的意思。
lines.en: Wings pressed low; that means I am about to strike.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕，圈子一圈比一圈紧。
lines.en: I loop above your head, each pass tighter than the last.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我在你正上方等风。
lines.en: Do not look up; I am overhead waiting for the wind.

lines.zh: 你的后背空着，我一直在看那里。
lines.en: Your back is open, and I keep looking at it.

lines.zh: 再数三下，我就下来。
lines.en: Count three more and I come down.

lines.zh: 我发出咯咯的叫声，这不是求偶。
lines.en: I make a clucking sound; it is not a courtship call.

lines.zh: 你握紧剑，我的爪子也收紧了。
lines.en: You tighten your grip on the sword; my talons tighten too.

lines.zh: 从这个角度，糖霜反光会先晃到你的眼。
lines.en: From this angle my icing glare reaches your eyes first.

lines.zh: 我等着你往前一步，就一步。
lines.en: I wait for you to take one step forward. One.

lines.zh: 我每绕一圈就低半格，你没察觉。
lines.en: Each loop drops me half a notch, and you never notice.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落地，那是倒计时。
lines.en: My shadow lands first; that is the countdown.

lines.zh: 一爪换来一块糖，值。
lines.en: One talon strike for a piece of sugar; worth it.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子，姜味沾上去了。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and leave the taste of ginger.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍你脸，这招不算光明正大。
lines.en: Wings across your face; not a fair move, I know.

lines.zh: 别用盾挡，我的喙会卡住。
lines.en: Do not raise the shield; my beak gets stuck in it.

lines.zh: 我的重量不大，落点却准。
lines.en: I am light, but I land exactly where I aim.

lines.zh: 你后退了，这说明我打得不错。
lines.en: You stepped back, so I must be doing well.

lines.zh: 爪子划开的伤口，会带着甜味。
lines.en: The cuts my talons leave carry a sweet smell.

lines.zh: 我不是在吃你，是在拆包装。
lines.en: I am not eating you, only opening the wrapping.

lines.zh: 这一击用了俯冲的全部力气。
lines.en: That strike used every bit of my dive.

lines.zh: 打中了，我的糖壳也裂了。
lines.en: A hit, and my sugar shell cracks too.

lines.zh: 糖树晃了一下，我从上面翻下来。
lines.en: The candy tree shook and I tumbled out of it.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，先闻到的全是肉豆蔻。
lines.en: I drop from the sky smelling only of nutmeg.

lines.zh: 这地方的甜味太浓，翅膀一下就黏住了。
lines.en: This place smells so sweet my wings stick at once.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼就饿了，这里有什么能吃的。
lines.en: I open my eyes hungry; what is there to eat here?

lines.zh: 我落在糖岩上，先看看有没有人。
lines.en: I land on a sugar rock and check for company.

lines.zh: 新生的翅膀还软，飞两下就得歇。
lines.en: New wings are soft; two flaps and I must rest.

lines.zh: 我闻到了曲奇，很远，但在下风处。
lines.en: I smell cookies, far off but downwind.

lines.zh: 这棵树上有旧巢，不知道是谁的。
lines.en: There is an old nest in this tree; no idea whose.

lines.zh: 我从糖雾里钻出来，羽毛全湿了。
lines.en: I come out of the sugar mist with wet feathers.

lines.zh: 第一次扇翅就撞到糖枝，真丢脸。
lines.en: My first wingbeat hit a candy branch; embarrassing.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的糖壳就化了。
lines.en: One touch of flame and my sugar shell melts.

lines.zh: 摔下去时我试着扇翅，来不及。
lines.en: I tried to flap on the way down; too late.

lines.zh: 糖做的鸟泡在水里，会散架的。
lines.en: A bird made of sugar comes apart in water.

lines.zh: 炸得我糖粒满天飞，像下雪。
lines.en: The blast scatters my sugar like falling snow.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膀，扎出一个圆洞。
lines.en: The arrow punched a round hole through my wing.

lines.zh: 魔法打过来，我的甜味都变淡了。
lines.en: Magic struck me and even my sweetness faded.

lines.zh: 两天没吃糖，我飞得直打晃。
lines.en: Two days without sugar and my flight wobbles.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身的糖都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and all my sugar burned black.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我的翅膀扇不动风。
lines.en: The void below gives my wings nothing to push.
